Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Hero Of A Thousand Devices]]: the cover of Joseph Campbell's book ''The Hero with a Thousand Faces''.

Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Joseph_Campbell_-_The_Hero_With_a_Thousand_Faces_-_Cover_Reprint.jpg Joseph Campbell - The Hero With a Thousand Faces - Cover Reprint.jpg], Wikipedia, shown on the Wikipedia article [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Hero_with_a_Thousand_Faces The Hero with a Thousand Faces]. Preserved copy of the article: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014041037/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Hero_with_a_Thousand_Faces Internet Archive], 14 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a reduced copy (300 pixels tall) of the cover of Joseph Campbell's book ''The Hero with a Thousand Faces'', the work the card's text refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of the work exists.
